title: Review Report (v1.2)
description: Final consolidated review report with conclusion, open items, tool failures, and review summary. Unclosed coverage or unresolved failures prohibit pass/pass_with_cautions. Single-written by the lead agent.

report_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this report.

scope.description: Explicit description of reviewed scope, exclusions, and incomplete areas.

inputs_version.description: References the manifest_id this report is bound to.

manifest_id.description: Must match the manifest_id from file-manifest.json.

coverage_ref.description: Reference to the coverage ledger with counts that must match the coverage recount.

planned_items.description: Must match recount from coverage items.

completed_items.description: Must match recount from coverage items.

failed_items.description: Must match recount from coverage items.

unchecked_items.description: Must match recount from coverage items.

conclusion.description: Overall conclusion. pass/pass_with_cautions require closed coverage, no unchecked items, no unresolved tool failures. partial_only/cannot_conclude used when coverage is incomplete or failures exist.

unresolved.description: Items requiring authorized human decision. Each entry is a non-empty string.

unchecked_items.description: Items that were not checked, with reasons.

reason.description: Why this item was not checked.

tool_failures.description: Recorded tool/capability failures. Unresolved failures (resolved≠true) block pass conclusions.

scope.description: Which part of the review was affected.

resolved.description: True if the failure has been resolved. Omit or set false when unresolved; do not use null.

resolution_notes.description: How the failure was resolved, if applicable.

review_summary.description: Optional summary from independent review. Null if no independent review has been conducted. When present, reviewed_count is required.

reviewed_count.description: Number of findings reviewed by the independent reviewer.

notes.description: Review notes. For downgraded/withdrawn findings, include exact issue_id references (e.g. 'I1: reason; I3: reason').

disclaimers.description: Additional disclaimers and limitations. Never null; defaults to standard assistance-level disclaimer.
